Patient is a 54-year-old presenting for follow-up of hypertension and hyperlipidemia. Blood pressure remains elevated at today's visit despite adherence to the current antihypertensive regimen. Lipid panel from last month showed persistent elevation in LDL cholesterol at 191 mg/dL.
